yes lets the bound Apps Script serve every tab as JSON to anyone with its URL (fine for a fictional sheet, never for real money). Anything else and the feed answers with a refusal.
Tax and data-quality checks over the raw data. Review means look at the rows before relying on the tax forecast.
A claim can be denied without written evidence.
Work equipment over the immediate-deduction limit
Items over the limit are depreciated over their effective life, and only the work-use share counts.
Renovating or replacing a whole asset is usually a capital improvement, not a deductible repair.
Only gifts to registered charities, with a receipt, are deductible. Crowdfunding for a person usually is not.
Rental property ran at a loss (prior year)
A rental loss is allowed, but keep every record that supports it.
A gap means a missing pay or a deposit in the wrong category.
They are left out of budgets and tax totals until categorised.
A typo in a category ID drops the row from every view.
Same merchant, amount, account and day. Usually a double charge worth disputing.
Transfers that do not net to zero
A one-sided transfer means an account feed is missing.
Interest means the card was not paid in full that month.
Rows dated after the as-of date are left out of every view.
Valuations missing for the as-of date
Property, super, shares, the car and both loans read as zero until their month-end values are entered, so net worth and the mortgage are wrong.
Valuations, one row per item in Assets
Salary deposits without a payslip (current year)
Gross pay and tax withheld come from payslips, so the tax forecast is wrong until every pay has one.
Bank import missing for the latest month
An everyday account or card with no rows this month usually means its statement was not imported.
Subscriptions charged but not on the list
A new subscription, often a free trial that rolled into a paid plan, is invisible to the usage and price checks until it is on the list.
Usually the same statement imported twice. Views look rows up by ID, so every ID must be used once.

A transfer needs a mate of the opposite amount on another account within four days; one without means a feed is missing or a payment was categorised as a transfer. Paired transfers never count as spending.
The month's change across every balance must equal income less spending plus valuation changes. Anything left over is a transfer with no mate, a row on the wrong account or a missing statement.
A receipt whose lines do not sum to its total is missing a line, a discount or a fee.
Card receipts with no bank row
A card receipt should point at the bank row it explains; without one the spending may be counted twice or not at all.
Spending outside the bank, latest month
Gift cards, cash and points are spending too. Each needs a spending row on Entries against its account.
Decisions with more than one pick
A decision should have one recommended option, or the comparison is ambiguous.
A recommended option still open past its decide-by date needs a decision or a new date.
Lodged years without a tax pack
A lodged year should link its tax pack folder so the notice and sources can be found together.
